scripts.build: bun run build:node && bun run build:rust
scripts.typecheck: bun run typecheck:node && bun run typecheck:evals
scripts.test: bun run test:node && bun run test:evals && bun run test:installers && bun run test:rust
scripts.test:node: bun run build:node && bun test packages/node
scripts.test:live: node scripts/prepare-node-addon.mjs && LIVE_KASB_TESTS=1 bun test packages/node/test/live
scripts.contracts:check: bun run build:node && node scripts/validate-contracts.mjs && node scripts/check-public-declarations.mjs && node scripts/generate-node-sdk-declarations.mjs --check && bun run release:check
scripts.conformance:judge: cargo build --locked -p kasb --example conformance_runner && node scripts/prepare-node-addon.mjs --judge && bun test conformance/judge.test.ts conformance/rust-sdk.test.ts conformance/cli-judge.test.ts conformance/node-sdk.test.ts
scripts.native:check: node scripts/generate-native-packages.mjs --check && node scripts/validate-native-workflow.mjs && node scripts/validate-glibc-floor.mjs --self-test
scripts.test:release-pipeline: node scripts/test-release-candidate.mjs && node scripts/test-release-publication.mjs && node scripts/execute-release-publication.mjs --self-test
